table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	customicode,
	alternatecustomicode,
	name, 
	compute_0002, 
	icode, 
	gcode, 
	batch, 
	expiry,
	saleprice, 
	discperc,
	claimable,
	claimablediscperc,
	SUM(looseqty) AS LooseQty, SUM(Bonusqty) AS BonusQty, 
	packunits, ReturnQty, 
	ReturnBonusQty, 
	TotalPieces = SUM(TotalPieces),
	ReturnedTotalPieces = SUM(ReturnedTotalPieces),
	unitsalestax, 
	gstperc,
	taxable = taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=ISNULL(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0),
	avgprice,
	salerowid,
	CommissionPerUnit=max(CommissionPerUnit),
	CommissionPerc=Max(CommissionPerc),
	max(saleitemdesc) AS saleitemdesc
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		dbo.item.name, 
		dbo.item.name + space(70) + str(dbo.item.icode) as compute_0002, 
		dbo.item.icode,
		dbo.item.customicode,
		dbo.saledetail.alternatecustomicode,
		dbo.saledetail.gcode,
		dbo.saledetail.batch,
		dbo.saledetail.expiry,
		saleprice=dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc,
		dbo.saledetail.discperc,
		dbo.saledetail.claimable,
		dbo.saledetail.claimablediscperc,
		dbo.saledetail.looseqty,
		dbo.saledetail.bonusqty,
		dbo.saledetail.packunits,
		dbo.saledetail.TotalPieces,
		dbo.saledetail.PiecesInHand,
		ReturnedTotalPieces = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.TotalPieces), 0.0000)
				FROM   	srledger, srdetail
				WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.SaleInvCode    and
					srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
					srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
					srdetail.icode       = item.ICode and
	/*				srdetail.gcode       = saledetail.GCode and
					srdetail.batch       = saledetail.Batch and
					srdetail.expiry      = saledetail.Expiry */
					srdetail.salerowid = saledetail.rowid),
		unitsalestax=dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax,
		gstperc=dbo.saledetail.gstperc,
		ReturnQty = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.looseqty), 0.0000)
				FROM   	srledger, srdetail
				WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.SaleInvCode    and
					srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
					srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
					srdetail.icode       = item.ICode and
	/*				srdetail.gcode       = saledetail.GCode and
					srdetail.batch       = saledetail.Batch and
					srdetail.expiry      = saledetail.Expiry */
					srdetail.salerowid = saledetail.rowid),
		ReturnBonusQty = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.bonusqty), 0)
				FROM   	srledger, srdetail
				WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.SaleInvCode    and
					srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
					srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
					srdetail.icode       = item.ICode and
	/*				srdetail.gcode       = saledetail.GCode and
					srdetail.batch       = saledetail.Batch and
					srdetail.expiry      = saledetail.Expiry */
					srdetail.salerowid = saledetail.rowid),
		 salerowid = dbo.saledetail.rowid,
		 saleitemdesc=dbo.saledetail.saleitemdescription,
		CommissionPerUnit=saledetail.CommissionPerUnit,
		CommissionPerc=saledetail.CommissionPerc,
		taxable = item.taxable,
		ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=ISNULL(saledetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0),
		AvgPrice=saledetail.AvgPrice
	FROM 
		dbo.item, dbo.saledetail	
	WHERE 
		( saledetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )and
		( item.icode = saledetail.icode ) and
		( saledetail.due IS NULL)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		dbo.item.name, 
		dbo.item.name + space(70) + str(dbo.item.icode) as compute_0002, 
		dbo.item.icode,
		max(dbo.item.customicode),
		dbo.saledetail.alternatecustomicode,
		dbo.Duesatisfydetail.gcode,
		dbo.Duesatisfydetail.batch,
		dbo.Duesatisfydetail.expiry,
		saleprice=dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc,
		dbo.saledetail.discperc,
		dbo.saledetail.claimable,
		dbo.saledetail.claimablediscperc,
		looseqty = sum(dbo.Duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty),
		Bonusqty=0.0000,
		dbo.saledetail.packunits,
		dbo.saledetail.TotalPieces,
		dbo.saledetail.PiecesInHand,
		ReturnedTotalPieces = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.TotalPieces), 0.0000)
				FROM   	srledger, srdetail
				WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = Duesatisfyheader.SaleInvCode and
					srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
					srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
					srdetail.icode       = Duesatisfydetail.ICode and 
		/*				srdetail.gcode       = Duesatisfydetail.GCode and
					srdetail.batch       = Duesatisfydetail.Batch and
					srdetail.expiry      = Duesatisfydetail.Expiry and */
					srdetail.salerowid   = Duesatisfydetail.salerowid),
		unitsalestax=dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax,
		gstperc=dbo.saledetail.gstperc,
		ReturnQty = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.looseqty), 0.0000)
				FROM   	srledger, srdetail
				WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = Duesatisfyheader.SaleInvCode    and
					srledger.posted      = 'Y' and 
					srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and 
					srdetail.icode       = Duesatisfydetail.ICode and 
		/*				srdetail.gcode       = Duesatisfydetail.GCode and
					srdetail.batch       = Duesatisfydetail.Batch and
					srdetail.expiry      = Duesatisfydetail.Expiry and */
		srdetail.salerowid   = Duesatisfydetail.salerowid),
		ReturnBonusQty=0.0000,
		salerowid = dbo.duesatisfydetail.salerowid,
		saleitemdesc=max(dbo.saledetail.saleitemdescription	),
		CommissionPerUnit=saledetail.CommissionPerUnit,
		CommissionPerc=saledetail.CommissionPerc,
		taxable = item.taxable,
		ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=ISNULL(saledetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0),
		AvgPrice=saledetail.AvgPrice
	FROM 
		dbo.item,   
		dbo.saledetail,
		dbo.duesatisfydetail,
		dbo.Duesatisfyheader
	WHERE 
		( saledetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )and
		( dbo.Duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) and
		( dbo.Duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode) and
		( item.icode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.icode ) and
		/*			( saledetail.gcode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.gcode) and */
		( saledetail.icode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.icode) and 
		( saledetail.RowId = dbo.duesatisfydetail.SaleRowId) and 
		( saledetail.due in ('S', 'D', 'X') )
	GROUP BY 
		item.icode,
		dbo.item.name,
		dbo.saledetail.alternatecustomicode,
		duesatisfydetail.icode,
		duesatisfydetail.salerowid,
		duesatisfydetail.gcode,
		duesatisfydetail.batch,
		duesatisfydetail.expiry,
		duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode,
		dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
		dbo.saledetail.commissionperc,
		dbo.saledetail.commissionperunit,
		dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc,
		dbo.saledetail.discperc,
		dbo.saledetail.claimable,
		dbo.saledetail.claimablediscperc,
		dbo.saledetail.packunits,
		dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax,
		dbo.saledetail.TotalPieces,
		dbo.saledetail.PiecesInHand,
		item.taxable,
		saledetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
		dbo.saledetail.AvgPrice,
		dbo.saledetail.gstperc) AS TMP
GROUP BY 
	icode, 
	name, 
	compute_0002, 
	customicode, 
	alternatecustomicode,
	gcode, 
	batch, 
	expiry, 
	saleprice, 
	discperc, 
	claimable,
	claimablediscperc, 
	packunits, 
	ReturnQty,
	ReturnBonusQty, 
	unitsalestax,
	gstperc,
	taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	avgprice,
	salerowid
ORDER BY 
	name, 
	expiry,
	batch
